calculation.description: Fades extended 60-day relative moves, scaling by 20-day volatility and directional efficiency over 40 days. The one-day shift ensures only completed data are used at signal formation. Higher values predict stronger subsequent returns over the 10-day decision horizon.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the full 2020-2029 synthetic cross-asset history; recent 250 observations remain positive (IC 0.023804, ICIR 0.091697), though materially weaker than the full sample.

signal_provenance.recompute: Load daily close for the 15 tradable assets; compute 60-day returns, subtract date-wise cross-sectional median, divide by 20-day return volatility times sqrt(60), multiply by 40-day directional efficiency (absolute rolling return sum divided by rolling absolute-return sum), negate, and shift one completed day.
